# Moving a video between two panels shows that it keeps playing

## Context

`examples/videoMove` moves a playing video from one panel to another without restarting it: a small, exact proof that the engine moves a DOM node instead of rebuilding it. #21140's target renews it for Workers & Platform ("a clip the project may show, the playback position visible across the move, dark"). #21312 delivered the clip. The rest has no leaf, and the record publishes no card (#21890).

## The Problem

Nothing on the page says that the video kept its position. A visitor sees a player jump from one box to the other and cannot tell a move from a reload. The example lands on a light theme, and its record `video-move` has no cover, so the group does not show it at all. The record's `scope` line still reads "Loads a sample MP4 from Apple's public media host", while the clip comes from `neomjs/pages` since #21312 (`examples/videoMove/MainContainer.mjs:48`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/videoMove/MainContainer.mjs`; the record `video-move` in family `platform`.
- The start theme resolves through `src/util/Theme.mjs` in the examples that land dark from the catalog (#21835).

## The Fix

Renew in place. The page shows the playback position before and after the move ("moved at 0:07, still playing at 0:07"), so the proof is a number a visitor can read. One line says what to try. The example takes its start theme from the catalog's link. The record's `scope` names the clip's real source. Its cover is the first frame, which publishes the card.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After a move the page shows the position at which the video was moved and that it is still playing from there.
- [ ] One line on the first frame names the action.
- [ ] Opened from the dark catalog the example is dark; the `scope` line matches the clip's host.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844.
- [ ] The record carries a cover from the first frame at 960 × 540 (through `neomjs/pages`), and Workers & Platform shows the card.
- [ ] The look: the first frame at both sizes and one frame after a move, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

`examples/component/video` (it becomes a tile in #21890). Changes to the video component.
